summary: Central Puerto S.A. filed a Form 6-K (equivalent to a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that the Company and its wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired 107,000 own book-entry ordinary shares via BYMA on 10/29/2026, settling 10/30/2026, at an average price of AR$1,851.46 per share for total cash of AR$198,106,863. The purchases represent a routine treasury-share buyback under Article 64 of Argentina's Capital Markets Law and stay within the 25% of 90-day average daily volume cap; no board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation terms were disclosed.
